title: Ollama Provider Architecture
context: Ollama runs locally, exposes OpenAI-compatible API at http://host:port/v1. No API key needed. Model discovery via /api/tags (not /v1/models).

decisions.question: How to discover models?
decisions.answer: GET http://{host}/api/tags, parse {"models": [{"name": "..."}]}. Different endpoint+format from OpenAI /v1/models.

decisions.question: What if Ollama not running?
decisions.answer: discoverModels returns error → log warning + create provider with 0 models. Do NOT fail setup/add-provider command.

decisions.question: Base URL pattern?
decisions.answer: http://{host}/v1 (default http://localhost:11434/v1). User passes --host flag (default localhost:11434).

decisions.question: Engine routing?
decisions.answer: Explicit else-if branch (same pattern as Cloudflare). Reuses openaiClient. Body identical to OpenAI else branch. Future hooks: tool calling, context-length, model-not-found fallback.

consequences: fetchModels in model_service.go needs ollama branch (different endpoint + response format)
No new DB columns needed — only CHECK constraint relaxation
API handler must skip api_key required check for ollama
openaiClient sends Authorization: Bearer with empty key — Ollama ignores, no change needed
